content.short: Running since 2011, Blockchain.com offers a self-custody wallet, a crypto exchange and one of the best-known Bitcoin block explorers.
content.description: Blockchain.com started in 2011 as a Bitcoin block explorer and is still one of the most used. Its wallet lets people hold Bitcoin, Ethereum and many other assets in self-custody. Next to it, the company runs a custodial exchange for buying and selling by card or bank transfer. A separate institutional arm handles custody, lending and OTC trades. It now describes itself as infrastructure for people, institutions and AI agents, with crypto-backed loans, an Earn product and a wealth service sitting next to the wallet and exchange.
content.meta: Self-custody wallet, exchange and long-running block explorer from one of crypto's oldest brands. Explore Blockchain.com on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
